<!----------------------------------------------------------------------
Before creating the pull request, please make sure you do the following:

- Check that there isn't already a PR that solves the problem the same way. If you find a duplicate, please help us review it.
- Ensure that the PR title follows conventional commits (https://www.conventionalcommits.org), with the provider as the scope when a change concerns one forge, for example `fix(gitlab): read nested group paths`.
- Run `pnpm check:all`. CI runs the same checks.
- Include relevant tests that fail without this PR but pass with it. For a new operation that reads from a forge, record a fixture instead of writing one by hand.
- Declare a capability `true` only when a test calls it, and run `pnpm capability-matrix` after you change a provider's capabilities.
- Update the corresponding documentation if needed.
- Add any additional context, tradeoffs, follow-ups, or things reviewers should be aware of.

Thank you for contributing to forges!
----------------------------------------------------------------------->
